expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a circular loading spinner centered over its hero image even though the image has clearly finished rendering behind it. The lingering overlay obscures the photo and suggests a broken image-load state.

The favorite heart buttons are inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first uses a white/transparent-outline heart with no visible container, while the second sits inside a dark filled circle.
The heart icon on the first card has very low contrast against the light noodle-bowl imagery, making the favorite control hard to see and tap-target unclear.
